title: Canonical build and analytical artifact manifest
scope: Canonical Velora operational PostgreSQL/Power BI build including governed enterprise telemetry, separately identified real-source MetroPT model reproduction, optional external benchmark artifacts, and the v1.0.0 public-release boundary.
execution_required_definition: True means the artifact is required by the canonical Velora operational build or its downstream regeneration from a governed materialized boundary. Real-source MetroPT model reproduction and the hydraulic benchmark remain optional even when their portfolio result is accepted.

status_definitions.accepted: Current canonical implementation or result for its stated purpose.
status_definitions.superseded: Retained historical implementation or result that must not be used as the current conclusion.
status_definitions.diagnostic: Inventory, feasibility, validation, or explanatory artifact; it may be mandatory to execute even though it is not an accepted analytical result.
status_definitions.supporting: Dependency, compatibility layer, runner, or documentation artifact that supports an accepted chain.
status_definitions.manual_input: Materialized input or assumption required by a chain but not created by the canonical clean-database sequence. Its stated provenance must be preserved.
status_definitions.generated: Reproducible runtime output, cache, log, derived data, or model binary that is not part of the public Git payload unless explicitly excepted.
status_definitions.external: Materialized third-party data governed by its source terms and acquisition route; code, provenance, and checksums are versioned while the data is excluded unless redistribution is explicitly approved.

release_treatment_definitions.include: Include in the public Git repository.
release_treatment_definitions.exclude_generated: Keep locally if useful but exclude from the public Git payload because it is generated or cache state.
release_treatment_definitions.external_acquisition: Exclude materialized data and reproduce it through the documented source route.
release_treatment_definitions.local_only: Exclude machine-specific, credential-bearing, deployment-state, or temporary material.

provenance_domains.velora_synthetic_enterprise: Fictional six-site enterprise integration data. It is synthetic and is not measured plant evidence.
provenance_domains.real_external_benchmark: Public real-world source data used only for benchmark, reference, weather-context, telemetry, or condition-monitoring demonstrations. It is not Velora operational data.
provenance_domains.mixed_benchmark: Synthetic Velora consumption combined with a real external benchmark, with both components kept identifiable.
provenance_domains.local_platform: Local PostgreSQL and Power BI implementation. Terraform is documentation-only and does not evidence AWS deployment.
